newsitem.title: ESTONIA: EBRD OK'S 15MLN DM SUBOR LOAN TO HANSA .
newsitem.headline: EBRD OK'S 15MLN DM SUBOR LOAN TO HANSA .

text.p: The Board of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) approved on Tuesday a 15 million mark subordinated loan to Estonia's Hansapank, the EBRD said on Wednesday.
"The final approval for the 15 million mark subordinated loan was given at yesterday's board meeting," Jonathan Hartfield, EBRD representative to Estonia, told Reuters.
The loan will form part of Hansapank's capital base and has a term of ten years, the EBRD said in an earlier statement.
The objectives of the loan include enabling Hansapank to expand it business activities, including its private sector loan portfolio and to contribute to the capitalisation of Hansapank.
"The approval of the loan highlights the positive state of of the financial system in Estonia," Hartfield added.
